children: Celanese Corporation (NYSE: CE), a global specialty materials and chemical company, today announced price increases for its ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMW-PE) and polyoxymethylene (POM) engineered materials products in response to various factors, including recent market developments and global supply chain disruptions.

The price increase will be effective on all shipments on or after Oct. 8, 2026, or as contracts otherwise allow. Additionally, individual grades may be subject to higher increase than specified below.
